title: Operation Rolling Thunder begins
description: The United States began Operation Rolling Thunder, the sustained bombing campaign against North Vietnam that marked a major escalation of the war during Larry's tour. Larry also remembers controversy or stories about aircraft dumping or jettisoning bombs into the ocean rather than attacking intended targets — a recollection the project is researching against documented procedures, rules of engagement, and period rumor.
researchNotes: The start date is well documented in official and secondary histories; a formal citation should still be added to the sources collection. The bomb-jettison recollection needs careful separation of documented emergency procedures, aborted missions, political restrictions, and contemporary rumor.
